All features working correctly: chart visualization for time-varying metrics (heart_rate, SpO2, blood_pressure, steps), gauge visualization for index metrics (BMI, visceral_fat), period selectors (24h/7j/30j/90j), Nora AI analysis per metric, and Tension bug fix verified (now navigates to blood_pressure, not heart_rate).
